compiled_state.author: Joe Oakhart
compiled_state.description: Unified demand-side cost-reduction program for rebar's LLM operations, the first line of defense in the layered spend-governance model (ahead of warning alarms and the hard cap). Goal: reduce steady-state token spend and peak-day spend while holding review quality, measured against existing per-review and per-ticket unit-cost baselines and the unit-economics dashboards. Children cover: batched code-review criteria passes, re-review cycle caps with explicit override, lower-cost model evaluation for Sonnet-tier operations, and lite review tiers for low-complexity work. Acceptance: each child lands with before/after unit-cost measurements; combined effect visible in the unit-economics metrics.
compiled_state.title: Reduce LLM gate unit costs (demand-side cost program)
